definitions.window: one (delivery_event_id, node_id) row of recall_delivery_history: the frozen 24h outcome horizon opened by one recall

classes.ask_follow: a later recall in the window echoed the delivered label or ask_hint under recall_map._echoes
classes.redelivered_only: neither exogenous probe fired and the frozen consumed bit (transport_consumed if transport_matched else fallback_consumed) is set

definitions.null_window: lookup_consumed IS NULL: the window closed before this database recorded any lookup, so its outcome is unobservable, not absent
definitions.ask_follow_applicability: only map-medoid windows carry a label; organic-tail windows are counted not_applicable rather than as a probe that found nothing

frozen_scorer_probe.question: with matured = 20 and consumed = 0, does a longer unfollowed tail lower the frozen relevance score?
frozen_scorer_probe.finding: the K term is monotonically increasing: a row delivered twenty times and consumed none of them scores higher the longer it has gone unconsumed. Demotion therefore cannot be obtained by feeding a better signal into trailing_nonconsumed; it has to be a gate applied outside the frozen zsum, which is also the only shape the frozen-evaluator boundary permits.
